book.name: 1 Korinti
book.title: KORINTI KINA'MI NKISA PORO KAENTIYE (KA YAGANE)

content: Isu purite asinti kamanane
Pigoya, nao'mitaba, aogi kamana urimuwagiri abintaka, to kake tiyogaritakena puwe. Pi aogi kamana urimuwagiri, tigeba maemagiri asima atokaema esegi puntawe.
Piya, aogi kamana uriminto kamanapa kampa uwaba abima kainta, araku'ma upebe punta, pi kamanatasa Kotiba ti'ikenaba piye.
Piya, mono ai'ne kamana nae maema urimintopa, pipa mayamawe: Karaisiti aeba mono isa'ama untisa puma aguntaenareka antota purintiye.
Aeba purogini arubi kaitauguna kakaga yaga a'ya pogana, mono isa'ama untisa puma purintapisa asitantiye.
Aepa asitaogana Pita nkaobi uma aboramagina, pitasa tonagisarisa tara tumpaema kina'wampi nkiyobi aborantiye.
Pitasa mono kina 500 kina'mi nkiyobi aboraogini kaga agawaentawe. Piya, igepisa ka'isamiba ago pu'wagana uwaenami iyogama mintawe.
Pitasa Yemisi nkaobi aboramagina, pitasa a'ya'ma aposoro kina'mi nkiyobi aborantiye.
Pigoya, a'ya'ma kina'mi nkika'i inare ntagara kanta puma aposoro aborauwagana, nae naobi aboraoga agantuwe.
Piya, naeba aposoro kina'mi nkikapi uwaenantora miyuwe. Naeba Koti mponota ai'aru pume kina'mipa karana puwaitantoka, wasanamiba aposorowe unamikenaenaba kampa kanara piye.

Pigoya, naeba Koti nkawagaenawatasa aposoronaba puntone. Piya, awagaenawampa naeti ataenaba kampa poga, naeba yoga punto'naba pipa igekeba igasaye. Nae nagu'ama kampa pogana, Koti nkawagaenawampa naeti wainti, pi'na puntiye.
Piya, naebe, igebaya, mono kamana urimintompepa, tigeba kanara abima aegarantawe.
A'ya'ma kina'mita asikena kamanane
Pigoya, Karaisitiba purintapisa asinti kamana taeba a'ya'ma yompepa, nana piyema tigetisa ka'isamiba: Purinta kina'mi asikenaenaba kampa waintiyema, yewe, a.
Piya, purintapisa asikenaenaba kampa waiyesinta, Karaisitiba kaga kampa asintesine.
Piya puma, Kotiba Karaisitipa kampa asitantesinta, mono ukenaenarepe timatiti'enaripe kaga a'yugu pemisine. Pi nkamanapa kampaye.

Piya, purintapisa asikenaenaba kampa taga waiyesinta, Kotiba Karaisitipa kampa asitantesine. We, taeba pi asitanti kamanapa umagi, kampa piya asitantesinta, taeba Koti kamanapa taga kampa aboraompesine.
Piya, purintapisa asikenaenaba kampa waiyesinta, Karaisitiba kaga kampa asintesine.
Eya, Karaisiti aepa purintapisa kampa asitantesinta, timatiti'enaripa a'yugu pegina aguntaenaripa wairitasine.
Piya, kampa asitantesinta, Karaisiti atokaema mima pure kinapa igeba kaga uwa pu'ma ata puwasine.
Eya, taeba ma mpabinkamana Karaisititi atokaeyompentana waiyesinta, igaikena tantara'ena taeti waiyesine.
Pigoya piyamaba kampaye. Karaisiti aepa taga purintapisa asitaogana, purinta kina'mipa paitawaitama asima mintiye.
Piya, purikenaenaba ka'waina agobiyogana, pabiyama purinta kina asikenaenaba to ka'waina agobintiye.
Eya, a'ya'ma kina'miteti Antamuge atokaekenaenare waintika, purune. Pabiyama Karaisitige atokaekenaenare waintika, taogama mikune.
Pigoya, mayama arabama asikune. Karaisiti aeba paitama asintika, taeba Karaisititi atokaeyompe kina'mitaba ae aborakibi ntagaba asiyekana,
tae taka'i nagarikiye. Piya, Karaisitiba asugasima a'ya'ma to esegiyenaba paitanta'enabe kabikenaenabe maegasima, kabiratakenaenara tabarempa Koti nkayata menkatakana nagarikiye.
Piya, Karaisiti kabiratakenaenaba mirite kanama, a'ya'ma kama kina'wapa agisa amentapinti atama aerapakana nagarikiye.
Eya, a'ya'ma kama kina'wapa maegasimagina, ika'i purikenaenaba kaga maegaikiye.

Piya, Kotiba a'ya'waemaena puma agisabi aki potantiyema, mono isa'ama piya iye. Pigoya, a'ya'waemaena puma agisabi aki potanti kamana'ama nkagoba taeba abokana, Koti taegeba agisabi kampa mintiye. Kampaye. Aeba aki puratagi, Karaisiti nkagisabi mintune.

Pigoya, ainti Koti aeba a'ya'waemaenaba agisabi aki puratakanaba, yagarawampa ae agisabi a'ya'maena aki puratakibi ntagarama nkagisabi ae'wa nkaupa menkatakiye. Piya pekanaba, Kotiba a'ya'waemaenama nkai'ne mikiye.
Pigoya, tigetisa ka'isamiba purinta kina'mi nkiyo'maekenaba mono wanipa to kakema maeyawe. We, purintapisa asikenaenaba kampa waintiye, yepa, pipa nana piyema piyamaba maeyawe.
Piya, purintapisa asikenaenaba kampa waintiye, yepa, nana piyema taeba taupa ata puratakena ki'i asi nasi nasune.
We, nao'mitaba, Karaisiti Isu Wa'egarempati naeba tigekaba na'mu potamagi, mayama tagaka urimuwe: Naepa a'ya'ma yaga purikenaenamaba agarosanatagi miyuwe.

Piya, Epesasi kumata kabu kara kanta pe kina'mi kamaena punatatakaba mabisa ikapa nana maekuwe. Pipa kampaye. We, purintapisa asikenaenaba kampa waintakapa: Aiba agora pu'wakubompeka ibaba iga nanintabe wanipe nama aogima miyeno, a.
Pigoya, a'yugu timiyo puritakiri abiyo: Ata pe kina'mige nasigini, aogiyenaripa ata puritakibewe.
Eya, tigeba tigu'ama pami puma arupu puma mima, aguntaenaba toba a-piyo. We tigetisa ka'isamiba Kotika aibosabo peka, pipa abima tini piyoma, yuwe.
Tau'ama asikibipa toma pukiye
Pigoya, ka'isamiba maya yewe: Purinta kina igeba aya pumabaya asikibewe. Aya iga puma asikibewe, piya yewe.
Pipa aibo kamanane. We, aintana potaganaba mabinti pu'wasu pumagina iraye.
Piya, aintana puntiripa, tigeba witi aorasawo, to ka aorasawo, maema aintana potaganaba, ayampuwampa iraye. Pipa tonawe. Pi nkaempurasaba kampa aintanaba pewe.
Piya, Kotiba aewa otagina aorasa ae'wa nkayampuwapa iraye. Piya, ka ka aintanamaba ae'wantana aboraye.
Piya, arirasaenama nkagoba pabiyama ka'antoba kampa waintiye. Wasanamite taupa pipa tomane. Yagawama nkaupa tomane. Kabarankama nkaupa tomane. Inoyantama nkaupa tomane.
Piya, mantabinti miye kina'mi nkipa tomane. Mabinti miye kina'mi nkipa tomane. Piya, mantara waita wantemintanama nkawa'enawapa tomane. Mara waita wantemintanama nkawa'enawapa tomane.
Piya, pankama nke'wasaenawapa tomane. O'ama nke'wasaenawapa tomane. Norimi nke'wasaenawaipa tomane. We, norimi nke'wasaenawaipa ka'mapa kampaye. Toma toma waintiye.
Pigoya, purintapisa asikenaenama nkagowapa pabiyaenawe. Piya, mamparasa taupa kaikenaena waintegina, asiratakibi tau'amaba kampa abararakenaenawe.
Piya, kaikena tau'ama nkageba maete tumegina, asikibemi tau'ama nkageba maete ikiye. Kaikena tau'amaba magimagi puma waintegina, asikibemi tau'amaba esegima aborakiye.
Kaikena tau'amaba ma au'yagane. Asikibemi tau'amaba manta au'yagane. Piya, mabisa tau waintikaba pabiyama manta tau aborakiye.
Pikaba mono isa'ama maya iye: Marusa yagara aboranti, Antamu, aeba agu'amantaga asintiye, iye. Pigoya, aintisa Antamu, pipa Karaisiti, aeba e'wasaena tamikena yagara aborantiye.
Piya, mantarasaenamaba kampa paitantiye. Mabisa tau'ama paitagina mantarasaenarepa ainti aboraye.
Piya, marusa yagaraba marasa pumarantikana mabisa kina'ena puntiye. Aintisa yagaraba aeba pipa mantabintisawe.
Piya, mabisa kina'mitaba pi mabisa yagara kanta pune. Mantari tage wainti kina'mitaba pi mantarasa yagara kanta pune.
Piya, mabisa yagarama nkaoga puntompeka, pabiyama mantarisa yagarama nkaoga pukune.
Nao'mitaba, ma kamana yopa abiyo: Mabisa tautempaba Koti kabiratakenaenabi kampa ubasikiye. Eya, awasakenaenamaba waiyaba'enabipa kampa ubasikiye.
Abiyo. Kakanta kamana kapa aborarimukuwe: A'ya'maba kampa pu'waekubompeka, pikuriyama aga yekapa a'ya'maba a'wae puma to tauga aborakune.
Piya, pikuriyama aga yekapa aorumo pisa puma karu'ena purinta mono kina'miba asima to kampa abararakibewe. Piya, a'ya'ma kina taeba a'wae puma to tauga aborakune.
Piya, abararanta tau'amaba a'wae puma miyaba'ena maeyano. Eya, puriyaba tau'amaba a'wae puma miyaba e'wasaena maeyano.
Pigoya, abararanta tau'amaba a'wae puma miyaba'ena maentini, pi puriyaba tau'amaba a'wae puma miyaba e'wasaena maeyigina, pabi ntagaba mono isapisa kamana'ama nkau'wapa aborakiye. Pipa mayamawe:

content.text: Purikenaenama nkire wantawapa aempa waintiye, iye.

content: Piya, aguntaenamaba purikenaenama nkwantapa waintegina, mono ago kamana'amaba piyama aguntaenama nkesegiyenaba taeti aboraye.
Pigoya, Koti aeba Wa'egare Isu Karaisiti otaogana, purikenaenama nkesegiyena atarama tao'maentika, Kotiti ta'mu potano.
We, nabugai ntao'mitaba, pika tigeba esegima asima aebebe puma miyiyo. Tigeba ago abintawe. Wa'egawamati araga ntuga piginaba, aeba uwaba kampa tigaikiye. Piya, Wa'egawama ntugagaba a-tiyekita piyo.
